description: When a session reaches a token or tool-call threshold, it writes a handoff document and starts a fresh session that continues from it, so one long session can never eat your whole context budget.

config.enabled: Master switch. When off, no listeners and no command are registered.
config.tokenThreshold: Absolute token-pressure threshold; 0 means use the window ratio below (default).
config.tokenThresholdRatio: Trigger at this fraction of the model context window (0.45 = 45% used). A hardcoded absolute value breaks when the window changes.
config.toolCallThreshold: Tool-call count at which the session is handed off; either threshold triggers.
config.handoffDir: Handoff directory relative to the session working directory; one subdirectory per session with index.md / facts.jsonl / full.md.
config.modelSummary: Generate the summary with the model; when off, a local fallback summary costs no extra tokens.
config.maxAutoHops: Maximum hops of the automatic continuation chain (chainLimit is the legacy name). Past it only the document is written and the session title is marked.
config.maxConcurrentHops: Maximum hops running in the same working directory; beyond it the handoff is deferred, not failed.
config.concurrentWindowMs: How long a deferred handoff waits before retrying (ms).
config.summaryMaxChars: Character cap for the model summary before it enters the document.
config.briefMaxChars: Hard character cap for the injected index.md.
config.briefTargetChars: Target length of index.md; past it the last optional section is dropped first.
config.goalMaxChars: Character cap for the goal section.
config.summaryTimeoutMs: Timeout in ms for a single summary model request.
config.maxTrackedFiles: Maximum number of touched file paths listed in the handoff document.
config.summaryProvider: Provider used for the summary; empty reuses the session's latest model.
config.summaryModel: Model used for the summary; empty reuses the session's latest model.
config.enforceMidTurn: Mid-turn hard fallback: hand off as soon as the tool-call threshold is passed, without waiting for the turn to end.
config.claimTtlMs: How long a claim is kept for the same session (ms). Claims are on disk and survive restarts.
config.retryCooldownMs: How long after a failed handoff before retrying (ms).
config.maxAttempts: Maximum automatic handoff attempts per session.
config.cancelParentAfterHandoff: Cancel the parent session's current turn after a successful handoff (its inbox is kept).
config.modelReview: L2 model review before handoff: one more model call, advisory only. Off by default.
config.reviewBlockOn: Which L1 rules block (no new session; wait for a manual /handoff).
config.toolErrorWarnRatio: Warn when the tool-error ratio exceeds this (errors / tool calls).
